title: Food and drink
subtitle: bread, fruit, vegetables, fruit juice
summary: Name everyday food, fast food, fruit, vegetables and drinks, and use uncountable words like bread and fruit correctly.

lesson.heading: Everyday food
lesson.text: **Bread**, **rice** and **pasta** are everyday food in many countries. We put **salt** and **pepper** on food, and **sugar** in tea or coffee. A person who never eats **meat** or **fish** is **vegetarian**.

examples.text: I love sushi because I love **rice**.
**Pasta** is good for you, but don't eat too much!
I always put **salt** on my chips, but not **pepper**.
My sister never eats meat or fish. She's **vegetarian**.

lesson.heading: Fast food
lesson.text: **Fast food** is food you can buy and eat quickly: **hamburgers**, **hot dogs** and **pizzas**. A **hot dog** is a sausage inside a piece of bread.

examples.text: I eat **hamburgers**, **hot dogs** and **pizzas** when I don't have much time.
**Fish and chips** is popular in Britain, Australia and New Zealand.
**Chips** are made from potatoes, and **hamburgers** are made from meat.

lesson.heading: Good for you
lesson.text: **Vegetables** are good for you, and **fruit** is good for you too. Remember that **fruit** is uncountable in English, so it takes a singular verb and has no plural.

lesson.heading: Drinks
lesson.text: The usual hot drinks are **tea** and **coffee**. Cold drinks are **milk**, **fruit juice** and **mineral water**. **Beer** and **wine** are drinks with alcohol.

examples.text: I have **tea** with **milk** and **sugar** in the morning.
A glass of orange **fruit juice**, please.

lesson.text: In a supermarket, look for food and drink with English names on them. Try to learn some of the words you see.

exercises.prompt: ___ is very popular in Japan. People eat it with sushi.
exercises.explanation: Rice is uncountable: I love rice.

exercises.prompt: Pasta and ___ are very popular in Italy.
exercises.hint: (you eat it with cheese and tomato on top)
exercises.explanation: Pizza is a popular Italian food, and also fast food.

exercises.prompt: A ___ is a sausage inside a piece of bread.
exercises.explanation: A hot dog is a kind of fast food.

exercises.prompt: Many British people eat ___ and chips.
exercises.explanation: Fish and chips is popular in Britain, Australia and New Zealand.
A vegetarian never eats meat or fish.
Garlic, onions and carrots are vegetables.
We put sugar in tea and coffee, and salt on food.

exercises.prompt: Match each drink with its description.

pairs.right: you make it from oranges or apples
water that comes in a bottle
a white drink that comes from cows
a hot brown drink many people have in the morning

exercises.statement: I love fruits and I eat some every day.
exercises.explanation: I love fruit and I eat some every day. Fruit is uncountable, so there is no plural.
Correct. Vegetables is plural, so the verb is are.

exercises.prompt: Ask politely for some bread at the table.
exercises.answer: Can I have some bread, please?
exercises.explanation: Bread is uncountable: say some bread, not a bread.
